fields.System.Title: TRF-404 — Investigate and resolve a discrepancy
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want to close a transfer discrepancy with a stated cause,
so that the adjustment is attributed to what actually happened.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an open discrepancy, then a cause must be chosen: origin picking error,
  • destination receiving error, loss in transit, damage in transit, or paperwork error.
  • - Given a cause of origin picking error, then the adjustment posts at the origin, not
  • the destination.
  • - Given a cause of loss in transit, then the stock is written off from
  • VIRT-INTRANSIT to VIRT-LOSS with approval.
  • - Given resolution, then the adjustment posts in one transaction with the discrepancy
  • closure and carries the discrepancy reference.
  • - Given resolution above the value threshold, then it requires approval from someone
  • other than the investigator.
  • - Given resolved discrepancies, then they are reportable by cause, by route, and by
  • carrier.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, inventory, platform |
| Tables | transfer discrepancy, adjustment, stock_balance, stock_movement |
| Risks | Adjusting the wrong side; unattributed write-offs ([doc 09 §9.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
